## What Is a Chief of Staff?

The Chief of Staff (CoS) serves as the CEO's strategic right hand — managing priorities, driving cross-functional initiatives, and ensuring organizational alignment. The role has grown 500% since 2019.

### The Role Defined

Core responsibilities:

- Strategic planning and execution tracking
- Cross-functional project management
- Meeting preparation and follow-up for CEO
- Board and investor relations support
- Internal communications
- Special projects and initiatives
- Team alignment and culture stewardship

### Who Gets Hired

| Background | Percentage | Why It Works |
|---|---|---|
| Management consulting | 35% | Structured thinking, executive presence |
| Investment banking / PE | 20% | Financial acumen, high-pressure performance |
| Internal promotion | 20% | Institutional knowledge, trusted relationship |
| Startup operators | 15% | Resourcefulness, pace comfort |
| Military officers | 10% | Leadership, organizational skills |

### Compensation

| Company Stage | Base | Total Comp |
|---|---|---|
| Startup (Seed-A) | $100K-$140K | $120K-$200K (incl. equity) |
| Growth (B-C) | $140K-$180K | $180K-$280K |
| Scale (D+) | $160K-$220K | $240K-$380K |
| Enterprise | $180K-$250K | $280K-$450K |

### Assessment Framework

Book a free 30-minute consultation with our team. No commitment, just practical advice.

#### Strategic Thinking (30%)

- Present a business challenge and ask for a 90-day action plan
- Test ability to synthesize complex information quickly
- Evaluate prioritization frameworks

#### Execution (25%)

- "Describe a complex cross-functional project you drove"
- "How do you track and ensure accountability across teams?"
- Evaluate project management methodology

#### Communication (20%)

- "Draft a board update email based on this data"
- Assess executive-level writing and presentation
- Test ability to distill complex topics

#### Judgment (15%)

- "The CEO asks you to handle a sensitive personnel issue. Walk me through your approach."
- Present ethical dilemmas and evaluate reasoning

#### Relationship Building (10%)

- "How do you build trust with executives who did not choose you?"
- Reference checks with former colleagues at all levels

### Common Mistakes

- Hiring someone too senior (they want their own team, not to support)
- Hiring someone too junior (they lack the judgment for CEO-level decisions)
- Not defining the role clearly (CoS becomes "catch-all")
- Expecting it to be permanent (most CoS roles are 2-3 year stints)

### Career Path After CoS

The CoS role is a launching pad:

- VP/SVP in a functional area (most common)
- COO or GM
- CEO of smaller company or startup
- Board member or advisor
- Return to consulting or investing
